exec: pm.test('Vehicle details are included', function () { const p=pm.response.json().dispatchPlan; if (p.length) { pm.expect(p[0]).to.have.property('capacity'); pm.expect(p[0]).to.have.property('currentAddress'); pm.expect(p[0]).to.have.property('totalDistanceKm'); } });
pm.test('Vehicle loads stay within capacity', function () { pm.response.json().dispatchPlan.forEach(v => pm.expect(v.totalLoad).to.be.at.most(v.capacity)); });
